title: Monitor Action Goal
text: Monitor action goal in ROS 2 network, 1 input, 4 outputs; {Name} sets the action name inherited from paired Send Action Goal block character, {Type} sets the action type inherited from paired Send Action Goal block character, {Paired Send Action Goal Block} sets the path to paired Send Action Goal block block, {Show Feedback output port} enables feedback output port and {Show ErrorCode output port} enables error code output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: UUID
ports.summary: Unique ID dedicated to any goal message non-virtual bus

ports.name: StatusCode
ports.summary: Execution status of action goal corresponding to UUID input scalar

ports.name: Result
ports.summary: Result message associated with a particular action goal non-virtual bus

ports.name: Feedback
ports.summary: Feedback message associated with a particular action goal non-virtual bus

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error conditions while monitoring action goal integer

params.name: Name
params.values: Action name inherited from paired Send Action Goal block character vector

params.name: Type
params.values: Action type inherited from paired Send Action Goal block character vector

params.name: Paired Send Action Goal Block
params.values: Path to paired Send Action Goal block block path

params.name: Show Feedback output port
params.values: Enable feedback output port off (default) | on

params.name: Show ErrorCode output port
params.values: Enable error code output port off (default) | on
